objective: Auto-generate C# POCO classes from JSON schemas and place them under Assets/Scripts/DataModels/ with Unity-friendly annotations.

steps.title: Inventory schemas
steps.description: Select schemas to generate models from (cards, blessings, equipment, skilltree).

steps.title: Define type mappings
steps.description: Map JSON Schema types and enums to C# types and enums.

steps.title: Generate classes
steps.description: Create .cs files with [Serializable] attribute and appropriate properties.

steps.title: Unity adjustments
steps.description: Ensure Unity-serializable types, add comments and namespace.

steps.title: Place files
steps.description: Write generated files to Assets/Scripts/DataModels/ and create Enums folder if needed.

steps.title: Optional editor utility
steps.description: Provide a Unity Editor menu item to re-run generation.

notes: Generate partial classes (*.generated.cs) to allow manual edits in separate files.
Use PascalCase for class and enum names.
Idempotent generation: overwrite only generated files.
